question: Can the identified rank-one carrier selectively enact a requested has-to-had edit from the base state and answer/foil readout alone, without using any confirmation-row donor activation to construct the intervention?

novelty_search.result: No prior donor-free aspectual actuator or margin-reflection test. Existing rank-one work always projects a paired donor-minus-base displacement or a paired program displacement.

frozen_design.calibration_rows: first eight lexical A1 rows, identical to the basis-fit subset
frozen_design.actuator: For each base state x and requested target/foil token pair, evaluate alpha on a fixed 257-point grid in [-B,B] and choose the smallest-index alpha minimizing |margin(x+alpha*q)+margin(x)|. The confirmation donor state is unavailable to this choice and is used only after selection as an A-family outcome reference.
frozen_design.P_semantics: Start from the noun-rewritten present-perfect P donor prompt, request had over has, and test whether the same actuator generalizes across the noun rewrite without a past-state donor.
frozen_design.C_semantics: Give the actuator its strongest fair attempt to reflect night/day within the same budget; low effect shows the carrier cannot enact an unrelated output edit.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_and_exact_he: Authority hashes, unit basis, native capability, and selected-token head reproduction all pass.
predictions.pred_b_budget_and_actuator_well_formed: B is finite and positive, exactly 257 grid points are used, and every confirmation intervention is a scalar multiple of q selected without its donor activation.
predictions.pred_c_heldout_lexical_actuation: Held-out lexical A1 reaches at least 0.50 mean donor recovery and 0.75 direction.
predictions.pred_d_cross_construction_actuation: Lexical A2 and fresh A1/A2 each reach at least 0.50 mean donor recovery and 0.75 direction.
predictions.pred_e_noun_shift_generalization: Lexical and fresh P noun-shifted starts each reach at least 0.50 of the requested margin reflection and 0.75 direction.
predictions.pred_f_unrelated_output_selectivity: Lexical and fresh C each move by at most 0.20 of the frozen A target scale despite optimizing alpha within the same budget.
predictions.pred_g_exact_coverage_and_price: All 120 confirmation rows are uniquely scored within 33 transformer forwards, 264 transformer-example evaluations, zero transformer backwards/updates, 30,840 two-token head grid evaluations, and one calibrated scalar.

terminal.screen: A-G pass: the carrier supports donor-free, target-guided, selective margin actuation on unseen constructions.
terminal.null: Authority and coverage pass, but target actuation, transfer, noun-shift generalization, or selectivity misses.
terminal.invalid: Authority, native capability, exact-head control, intervention construction, or coverage fails.
